author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
This is the old area control system and is definitely prone to the problems you described. I highly recommend building a Conqueror's guild. It will replace the current area control system with a different one where you capture buildings that spawn all over instead. There are positions for 3**, 5*, 7*, 9* and 10* in  each building. High level players get  to have characters in the low tier positions too, called Othersouls, but you don't get a class. That means your stats are much lower and you have no passives, but you do get  to wear gear. Normal players can definitely take zones from othersouls with a bit of effort.

Overall, the new system is a lot more friendly leveling up.

author: QuoteGiver
body:
I think about it like this:  anywhere I go to play Orna, someone who is way more committed to the game than I am can certainly have gone too!  And they’ve been playing for *years*.

I played a LOT for a while and saw how much MORE some of these other folks played.  If you have another hobby of some kind, that doesn’t allow you to grind Orna at the same time, then you aren’t these top-100 folks.  They are doing this one thing, all the time.  And for the PvP folks, lots and lots of driving!

author: Intelligent-Ask-2121
body: There is a new area control gameplay.  The Conqueror's Club is about control of settlements.  There are 5 tiers to the Settlements so lower level players can participate.  Note that even after you move over to Conqueror's Club you'll find that Sir Oinksworth controls many of the settlements in the territories he once owned.
